sourceFile: 65.BRS-2015 Report checking NTI  sample change bonding line VP+CD offset 0.1 date 23.7.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has a valid comparison context but misstates the changed factor and lacks complete row-level evidence for final use.
issues: Changed factor is the filename instead of Normal vs Offset 0.1 bonding-line VP+CD offset condition.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked not explicit despite cited rows showing Normal and Offset 0.1 groups.
Changed-factor evidence omits Fo offset rows and relies on incomplete header-only citations for several sheets.
Outcomes are poorly grouped, mixing SPL, THD, IMP and Fo under generic detected-table stats.
Graph!39 is used without supplied row context, so its role cannot be verified here.
correctionPlan: Set baselineCondition to Normal samples and changedCondition to Offset 0.1 samples, with ST as reference target if applicable.
Rename changedFactor to the actual bonding-line VP+CD offset 0.1 sample change.
Add cited rows for both Normal and Offset 0.1 data on Fo and representative data rows for SPL, THD and IMP.
Separate outcome metrics by sheet/domain: Fo, SPL, THD and IMP, preserving sample groups and averages.
Remove or explain Graph!39 unless its row content supports a specific plotted outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence because key changed-condition and metric data rows are missing or header-only.
